text: As the Third Vice President and City of Toronto the Board of Directors representative, I attended the Board of Directors Meetings on September 26 and September 27, 2024. The meetings provided insights into the current state and future direction of road infrastructure and transportation. The meetings focused on: -Policy Updates: The meeting offered a platform to discuss and understand the latest policy developments and initiatives related to road infrastructure.
